description: This file provides utilities for encoding and decoding Kubernetes API discovery responses, specifically implementing a 'strip version' encoder to maintain backward compatibility by removing API version info from responses.

classes.name: stripVersionEncoder
classes.description: A custom encoder that strips the API version from objects for backward compatibility.

classes.name: stripVersionNegotiatedSerializer
classes.description: A serializer that returns a stripVersionEncoder for encoding, implementing negotiated serialization.

methods.name: newStripVersionEncoder
methods.description: Creates a new stripVersionEncoder with specified encoder and serializer.

methods.name: identifier
methods.description: Generates a runtime.Identifier for the encoder, marshaling a JSON object with encoder info.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a runtime.Object, stripping version info if applicable.

methods.name: doEncode
methods.description: Performs the actual encoding, decoding to remove version info, and re-encoding.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the encoder.

methods.name: EncoderForVersion
methods.description: Returns a stripVersionEncoder for a specific API version, for backward compatibility.
